preconditions.description: Number of vertices is between 1 and 100,000.
Number of edges of weight 1 is between 0 and the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].
No edge appears more than once in the input.

postconditions.description: The output is the weight of the minimum spanning tree of the graph.
